content_sections.heading: ICSIL Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ICSIL Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ICSIL Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ICSIL Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Lead Project Associate (Accounts): Post Graduate from a recognized university/institution Minimum 06 years full time work experience in a govt. Department. Sr. Project Associate (Planning): Post graduate in environment studies, Urban planning, Forest Management and allied sciences from a recognized university institution. OR B.Tech/BE/B. Arch Degree from a recognized university/institution Minimum 4-6 years full time work experience in a govt. department

content_sections.heading: ICSIL Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Lead Project Associate (Accounts): Maximum age limit is 40 years. Sr. Project Associate (Planning): Maximum age limit is 35 years. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 17-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of ICSIL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICSIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the ICSIL recruitment is 17-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this ICSIL recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Lead Project Associate (Accounts) and Sr. Project Associate (Planning).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Lead Project Associate (Accounts)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree from a recognized university or institution for the Lead Project Associate (Accounts) position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Sr. Project Associate (Planning)?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Sr. Project Associate (Planning) post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for ICSIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for all candidates is Rs. 590/- which is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Lead Project Associate (Accounts)?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for Lead Project Associate (Accounts) will receive a salary of Rs. 77,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these ICSIL posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official ICSIL website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ICSIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny of documents followed by an interaction or interview.

faq.question: Q9. Does ICSIL offer any age relaxation?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify any age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for further information.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These positions are on a contract basis.
